lead_raw_text:
The structure of Sr2Mg12Ag2 (SrMg6Ag) crystallizes in the orthorhombic space group Amm2 (No. 38), with 16 atoms in the unit cell distributed over six independent Wyckoff orbits. Geometry-derived analysis identifies close-packed-like local arrangements for all centers: Ag and Sr each have 12 geometric neighbors, while Mg centers show 12 neighbors with varying Ag, Mg, and Sr compositions. The geometric neighbor graph forms a single three-dimensional component spanning all 16 sites. Validated polyhedron-sharing analysis reveals Mg-centered 12-vertex coordination polyhedra sharing corners, edges, and faces in several observed patterns.
